# Mesnium Brand Assets

This directory serves as the dedicated container for all user-provided Mesnium visual assets and brand elements.

## Asset Locations:
- `logo.svg` - Primary Mesnium vector logo (full lockup)
- `icon.svg` - Mesnium app symbol / glyph (square / standalone icon)
- `favicon.ico` - Multi-size browser favicon
- `apple-touch-icon.png` - 180x180 mobile touch icon
- `fonts/` - Custom typography files (Inter, Outfit, etc.)
- `creatives/` - Marketing / splash creatives & wallpapers

*Note: Final visual assets will be supplied by the user during the UI redesign phase.*
